pattern.description: A row of vertical audio-waveform bars shrinks into dots and drifts up out of frame while the headline 'Every note' rises from below into the centre, so the voice visual hands off to the words it produced.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous upward motion links the two states (sound becomes text) instead of a cut; the bars collapse to dots before vanishing, which reads as the audio being converted rather than simply removed.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.bar', {scaleY: 0.1, y: -40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.in', stagger: {each: 0.01, from: 'center'}}).fromTo('.headline', {y: 40, opacity: 0}, {y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.03')
build_hint.remotion: bars: scaleY/translateY/opacity via interpolate(frame, [0, 6], ...) with Easing.in(Easing.quad); headline: translateY = interpolate(spring({frame: frame - 1, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 180, mass: 1}}), [0, 1], [40, 0]) with opacity 0->1 over the same spring.

notes: Waveform bars are gone in the end frame; b01 (union box) covers the area they occupied, so it is used for the bars. Filmstrip frames are crops around b01. Bars may be read as a decorative element rather than an icon (role 'icon' chosen as closest).
